data.font_license_note: This submission uses Noto Sans SC (SIL Open Font License 1.1) as the rendering font across all asset layers. PDF/PNG deliverables embed glyph subsets via matplotlib (font manifest NotoSansSC, weights 400/700). The 4 HTML deliverables embed a re-subset v14 woff2 (1270 glyphs; Regular 310 KB + Bold 313 KB → base64 403 KB + 407 KB) as @font-face{font-family:'JZEmbedCJK'} data URIs (src local-first + data-URI fallback; font-family stack explicitly hits every element — issue #3978 verified parameters). The package does NOT ship a standalone font binary. The full OFL-1.1 text is reproduced in report/copyright_statement.md; stable license/source URLs are provided. Reserved Font Name 'Noto Sans SC' is retained (OFL §1 Reservation of Name). Per v14 itemized status this font use is 'documented + pending legal re-review', not self-certified as fully cleared.
data.code_license: Generation scripts released under MIT License in ltf0109/urban-planning-ai-kit.
data.clearance_conclusion: Evidence-proportionate, itemized — NOT an 'all assets cleared' assertion (v15). All submitted text/geometry/code/metrics/multimodal figures are original works by EvidenceRail Agent (ltf0109) and its subagents, with no third-party generative-AI assets of unclear ownership. For usable_for_formal=no background-only sources (HAIDIAN-*/ORIGIN-*/HERITAGE-*/SANQU-LIANGYI), only their viewpoints/mechanistic inspiration are cited — no third-party asset is copied or redistributed, and they are not used as formal evidence or formal claims. The seven TOP-*/DZDP entries with no stable permalink were deleted in v13; their mechanism-heuristic prose is retained as common urban-planning knowledge, not as sourced claims. Per-asset itemized status (v15): ① font = Noto Sans SC, OFL-1.1, license text shipped, Reserved Font Name retained — status 'documented + pending legal re-review'; ② AMap aggregate data = use boundary declared (aggregated stats / H3 res9 grids / GCJ-02→WGS-84 coordinates only; no raw POI details), but service-terms version is NOT self-verified (v2024 is inferred; sandbox cannot reach lbs.amap.com) — status 'aggregate use + pending clause verification + pending legal authorization'; ③ OSM = REMOVED from the current build (v15): osm_roads_basemap.geojson drawing and the '© OpenStreetMap (ODbL)' footer were removed from generate_boards.py; no OSM tiles or OSM-derived data remain in any deliverable (PNG/PDF/HTML); osm_roads_basemap.geojson exists only in the working directory and is not shipped — status 'no OSM data in submission'. Nothing here is represented as completed clearance. Professional legal itemized review is a REQUIRED precondition (not optional) before formal exhibition/publication (copyright_statement.md v15 §2.2).
